name: Changning AI Industry Projects, 2026
zh: 2026长宁人工智能产业项目
amount: Project-specific support after assessment; no common ceiling established
amountZh: 项目经评估给予支持，未确定统一上限
eligibility: Lawfully established Changning legal or non-legal-person organizations with normal operations and good credit. The call covers multiple AI, software, technology-service and market-development directions.
eligibilityZh: 长宁依法设立、经营正常且信用良好的法人和非法人组织，覆盖人工智能、软件、科技服务及市场拓展等方向。
deadline: Closed 30 June 2026
deadlineZh: 已于2026年6月30日截止

name: Changning Technology Star Teams, 2026
zh: 2026长宁科技之星团队
amount: Funding for assessed and recognized teams under the district talent fund plan
amountZh: 依区人才资金计划对评审认定团队给予支持
eligibility: Eligible teams in AI, industrial internet and biomedicine at organizations established or operating lawfully in Changning. Required evidence includes research outcomes, employment contracts and commitments.
eligibilityZh: 在长宁依法设立或开展经营单位的人工智能、工业互联网及生物医药等团队，须提供科研成果、劳动合同及承诺等。
deadline: Closed 26 June 2026
deadlineZh: 已于2026年6月26日截止

name: Putuo Technology Enterprise Seed Plan, second 2026 batch
zh: 2026普陀科创企业种子计划第二批
amount: RMB 300,000 per selected company; 50% initially, remainder after one-year development review
amountZh: 获选企业30万元，首期50%，一年后按发展情况拨付余款
eligibility: Lawfully established technology companies with good credit. Online application is accompanied by stamped paper materials through the responsible investment promotion center; the science commission evaluates the project.
eligibilityZh: 依法设立且信用良好的科创企业，线上申报并向对应投促中心提交盖章纸质材料，由区科委组织评估。
deadline: Closed 31 August 2026
deadlineZh: 已于2026年8月31日截止

name: Putuo intelligent software industry support, 2026
zh: 2026普陀智能软件产业专项
amount: Direction-specific R&D, compute, first-product matching and related support
amountZh: 按研发、算力、首台套首版次配套等方向支持
eligibility: Good-credit legal or non-legal-person organizations. The call distinguishes R&D collaboration, compute use for models and agents, recognized technical breakthroughs and other directions; approval and eligible periods differ.
eligibilityZh: 信用良好的法人或非法人组织，分别设置产学研、模型及智能体算力、认定技术突破等方向，审批及支出期间各异。
deadline: Closed 26 June 2026
deadlineZh: 已于2026年6月26日截止

name: Putuo R&D Platform Projects, 2026
zh: 2026普陀科技研发平台项目
amount: Up to RMB 2 million; first payment at most 50%, balance subject to acceptance
amountZh: 最高200万元，首期不超过50%，余款按验收情况拨付
eligibility: Lawfully established, good-credit legal or non-legal-person organizations building qualifying R&D platforms. Online registration requires district review; credit commitments and prescribed materials are required.
eligibilityZh: 依法设立、信用良好并建设合资格研发平台的法人或非法人组织；线上注册须区级审核，并提交信用承诺及规定材料。
deadline: Confirm the deadline in the September 2026 notice
deadlineZh: 核验2026年9月通知中的具体截止日

name: Songjiang technology-enterprise innovation and matching support
zh: 松江科技企业创新与配套支持
amount: District innovation project up to RMB 100,000; approved municipal innovation projects matched 1:1 under the policy
amountZh: 区级创新资金每项最高10万元，市级创新资金立项按政策1:1配套
eligibility: Qualifying technology enterprises under the 2026-2027 measures and implementing rules. Different recognition, commercialization and voucher provisions must be checked separately.
eligibilityZh: 符合2026至2027年措施及实施细则的科技企业；认定、成果转化及创新券条款须分别核验。
deadline: Policy: 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2027; confirm the applicable call
deadlineZh: 政策有效期2026年1月1日至2027年12月31日，须核验相应申报
status: Policy in force; call not confirmed open

name: Qingpu digital economy compute reimbursement, September 2026 costs
zh: 青浦2026年9月算力费用补贴
amount: Amount under the applicable digital-economy rules; reviewed against eligible actual cost
amountZh: 依数字经济适用规则及合资格实际支出审核
eligibility: Eligible R&D rental of non-related-party intelligent compute; storage, networking and security are excluded. The provider must hold the specified IDC/ISP licence. Other fiscal support for the same project and year is generally excluded.
eligibilityZh: 非关联方智能算力研发租用，不含存储、网络及安全；供应商须持规定IDC/ISP许可，同项目同年度原则上不重复财政资助。
deadline: Closed 23 October 2026, 17:00 China Standard Time
deadlineZh: 已于2026年10月23日中国标准时间17:00截止

name: Fengxian R&D expenditure increase reimbursement, 2026
zh: 2026奉贤研发费用增长补贴
amount: 30% of the qualifying annual R&D net increase, capped at RMB 1 million
amountZh: 合资格年度研发净增部分30%，最高100万元
eligibility: Valid recognized high-tech enterprise or 2025 registered technology SME; 2024 and 2025 tax finalization and R&D super-deduction schedules are required. Submit online and route the paper pack through the recommending unit.
eligibilityZh: 有效期内高企或2025年入库科技型中小企业，须完成2024及2025年汇算清缴和研发加计扣除明细；线上申报并经推荐单位递交纸质材料。
deadline: Online closed 17 June 2026, 17:00; paper closed 30 June 2026, 17:00 China Standard Time
deadlineZh: 线上已于2026年6月17日17:00截止，纸质已于6月30日17:00截止，均为中国标准时间

name: Fengxian SME Technology Innovation Key Projects, 2026
zh: 2026奉贤科技型中小企业技术创新资金重点项目
amount: Up to RMB 250,000; generally two installments, final settlement after acceptance
amountZh: 最高25万元，一般分两期，验收后结清
eligibility: The 2026 key-project call requires prior-year revenue RMB 30m-200m, R&D at least RMB 1.2m and 4% of revenue, at most 500 employees and at least 10% R&D staff, plus additional conditions.
eligibilityZh: 2026重点项目要求上年营收3000万元至2亿元、研发不少于120万元且占营收4%、职工不超过500人、研发人员不少于10%，并有其他条件。
deadline: Online closed 21 June 2026; paper closed 30 June 2026
deadlineZh: 线上已于2026年6月21日截止，纸质已于6月30日截止

name: Chongming early-stage enterprise development subsidy, 2026
zh: 2026崇明初创助力发展补贴
amount: Up to RMB 100,000 for an assessed excellent qualifying early-stage project
amountZh: 经区级评审为优秀的合资格初创项目，最高10万元
eligibility: Startup organizations incubated in a carrier or closely supported by a township park, with qualifying emerging-industry or niche innovation and growth potential. The July policy is distinct from the expired 2024 science measures.
eligibilityZh: 在创业载体孵化或乡镇园区重点帮扶、具有合资格新兴产业或细分领域创新及成长潜力的创业组织；7月政策不同于已失效的2024年科技办法。
deadline: Policy: 1 August to 31 December 2026, with qualifying cases since 1 January; confirm intake
deadlineZh: 政策2026年8月1日至12月31日有效，符合条件的1月1日以来事项参照执行，须确认受理
status: Policy in force; call not confirmed open

name: Hongkou international and overseas young talent support, first 2026 batch
zh: 2026虹口国际顶尖及海外优秀青年人才扶持第一批
amount: Recognized top talent and core team: up to RMB 1m; eligible overseas young talent: RMB 50,000 per person
amountZh: 认定顶尖人才及核心团队最高100万元，合资格海外优秀青年人才每人5万元
eligibility: Strict category-specific talent recognition and Hongkou employment rules apply. Email pre-review is followed by paper submission at the district talent service center; this is not a grant for every foreign founder.
eligibilityZh: 适用严格分类人才认定及虹口就业条件；邮箱预审后到区人才中心交纸质材料，并非所有外籍创始人均可申请。
deadline: Closed 31 March 2026
deadlineZh: 已于2026年3月31日截止

name: Jiading Future Industry Fund
zh: 嘉定未来产业基金
amount: Announced fund scale RMB 800 million; individual investment not established
amountZh: 公布基金规模8亿元，单笔投资未确定
eligibility: Projects within the fund manager's current future-industry mandate. Confirm the responsible manager, direct or subfund route, stage and domicile requirements. Fund scale is not a per-company award.
eligibilityZh: 符合管理人现行未来产业投资范围的项目，须确认管理人、直投或子基金路径、阶段及属地要求；基金规模非每家企业获资额。
deadline: Manager-led sourcing; current deal intake to confirm
deadlineZh: 管理人筛选项目，当前受理待确认
status: Fund announced; deal intake to confirm

name: Baoshan pre-investment / later equity project call
zh: 宝山先投后股项目征集
amount: Amount and conversion terms require the actual project guide and agreement
amountZh: 额度及转股条件须以项目指南及协议为准
eligibility: The district January 2026 policy calendar identifies a science-commission call for pre-investment / later equity projects. Verify the recipient, milestone and conversion conditions rather than labelling this an unrestricted equity-free grant.
eligibilityZh: 区级2026年1月政策月历列明科委先投后股项目征集，须核验主体、里程碑及转股条件，不能视为自由使用的不占股补助。
deadline: Closed 10 February 2026
deadlineZh: 已于2026年2月10日截止

name: Huangpu financing and credit product directory
zh: 黄浦融资信用产品目录
amount: Product-specific bank credit, startup guarantee and IP-backed finance
amountZh: 各银行授信、创业担保与知识产权融资产品条件各异
eligibility: Select the actual bank product on the official district platform. Credit eligibility, guarantee, rates, fees, collateral and repayment depend on the lender and company; the directory is not an approval.
eligibilityZh: 在区级官方平台选择具体银行产品，授信资格、担保、利率、费用、抵押及还款依银行与企业确定，列入目录不代表获批。
deadline: Product-specific; confirm current lender terms
deadlineZh: 依具体产品，核验贷款方现行条件

name: Yangpu financing and credit service platform
zh: 杨浦融资信用服务平台
amount: Product-specific technology credit and IP finance; no universal ceiling
amountZh: 科技信贷及知识产权融资依具体产品，无统一上限
eligibility: Use the district platform to identify an actual lender and product. Technology performance-guarantee lending, IP-backed products and guarantees have different duties and underwriting conditions.
eligibilityZh: 通过区级平台确认实际贷款方及产品，科技履约贷、知识产权融资与担保产品的义务和审核条件不同。
deadline: Product-specific; confirm current lender terms
deadlineZh: 依具体产品，核验贷款方现行条件

name: Jing'an Service Industry Guidance Fund and AI Demonstration Support, 2026
zh: 2026静安服务业发展引导资金与人工智能示范支持
amount: Project-specific support under the district service-industry guidance fund rules, matched to qualifying project investment
amountZh: 依区服务业发展引导资金办法给予支持，按合资格项目总投资及类别核定
eligibility: Lawfully registered, tax-paying legal-person organizations in Jing'an with sound credit, advancing modern services, enterprise AI, data services or digital commerce under the 2026 batch rules and 2026-2028 AI demonstration plan.
eligibilityZh: 在静安依法设立、纳税且信用良好的法人组织，符合2026年申报通知及2026至2028年人工智能创新应用示范区方向的现代服务业、企业人工智能、数据服务或数字商业项目。
deadline: Second 2026 batch published May 2026; confirm current sub-district recommending window
deadlineZh: 2026年第二批通知于5月发布，须向所属街镇或功能区确认当前推荐受理窗口

name: Zhangjiang Jinshan Park low-altitude UAV and new materials support
zh: 张江金山园低空无人机与新材料创新支持
amount: Policy-specific R&D, carrier incubation, testing-service and industrialization support under the 2025-2026 park action plan
amountZh: 依2025至2026年园区行动方案及张江专项政策给予研发、载体孵化、检测服务及产业化支持
eligibility: Qualifying enterprises and innovation carriers in Zhangjiang Jinshan Park working on low-altitude UAV systems, new chemical or electronic materials, biomanufacturing and intelligent equipment.
eligibilityZh: 张江金山园内从事低空无人机系统、化工与电子新材料、生物制造及智能装备的合资格企业与创新载体。
deadline: Policy: 2025 to 2026 action plan; confirm current implementing batch
deadlineZh: 2025至2026年行动方案有效，须核验当前实施批次
status: Policy in force; call not confirmed open

name: Yangpu Dream Start Angel Co-investment Fund
zh: 杨浦梦想起航天使引投基金
amount: District state-backed early-stage equity co-investment; individual cheque subject to investment committee review
amountZh: 区级国资早期股权引投基金，单笔投资额经投委会审议确定
eligibility: Early-stage hard-tech, quantum computing, brain-inspired AI and university spinout enterprises settling or operating in Yangpu alongside qualifying lead investors.
eligibilityZh: 落户或在杨浦经营、并获得合资格领投机构协同投资的硬科技、量子计算、类脑智能及高校成果转化早期企业。
deadline: Manager-led sourcing and due diligence
deadlineZh: 管理人开展项目筛选与尽调

name: Songjiang Data Elements Special Fund, second 2026 batch
zh: 2026松江区数据要素专项资金第二批
amount: Project-specific support under the district data-elements special fund rules
amountZh: 依松江区数据要素专项资金管理办法按核定项目给予资助
eligibility: Lawfully operating Songjiang organizations developing high-quality datasets, corpus governance, data-product listings or AI data-space applications.
eligibilityZh: 在松江依法经营、开展高质量数据集建设、语料治理、数据产品挂牌或人工智能数据空间应用的单位。
deadline: Second 2026 batch notice issued August 2026; confirm current acceptance status
deadlineZh: 2026年第二批通知于8月发布，须核验当前受理状态

name: Qingpu Enterprise Intelligent Transformation Support Fund, 2026
zh: 2026青浦区企业智能化改造扶持资金
amount: Proportion of verified intelligent equipment, industrial software and digital-workshop investment
amountZh: 按经核定的智能装备、工业软件及数字车间投入比例给予扶持
eligibility: Qualifying Qingpu manufacturing and technology enterprises implementing intelligent factories, industrial AI inspection or digital supply-chain upgrades.
eligibilityZh: 在青浦实施智能工厂、工业AI视觉检测或数字化供应链升级的合资格制造与科技企业。
deadline: 2026 notice issued 31 July 2026; confirm current batch window
deadlineZh: 2026年通知于7月31日发布，须核验当前批次受理窗口

name: Fengxian South Shanghai Sci-Tech Center "Open Competition" R&D Projects, 2026
zh: 2026奉贤“南上海科创中心”揭榜挂帅合作项目
amount: Milestone-based R&D grant matched to technical challenge contract value
amountZh: 结合技术攻关合同额按里程碑给予研发补助
eligibility: Enterprises, universities and research institutes jointly tackling published core technical bottlenecks in robotics, biomedicine, new materials or green chemistry in Fengxian.
eligibilityZh: 针对奉贤发布的机器人、生物医药、新材料或绿色化工关键技术需求开展联合攻关的企业、高校及科研院所。
deadline: 2026 guide published May 2026; confirm current project batch
deadlineZh: 2026年申报指南于5月发布，须确认当前批次时间

name: Chongming Entrepreneurship and Innovation Competition & Policy Support, 2026
zh: 2026崇明区创业创新大赛与联动扶持
amount: Competition awards plus priority routing to district startup subsidies, carrier incubation and guaranteed loans
amountZh: 赛事奖金及优先对接区初创补贴、孵化载体与创业担保贷款
eligibility: Startup teams and early-stage enterprises aligned with Chongming ecological tech, smart agriculture, marine equipment, green energy and digital economy.
eligibilityZh: 符合崇明生态科技、智慧农业、海洋装备、绿色能源及数字经济方向的创业团队与初创企业。
deadline: Implementation plan issued 20 August 2026; check track schedule
deadlineZh: 实施方案于2026年8月20日印发，须核验赛程安排
status: 2026 competition published; track intake to confirm

name: Lin-gang Zero Cube conditional rent support
zh: 临港零界魔方有条件办公租金支持
equity: No equity stated in offer; verify terms
amount: Qualifying offices: 3 years rent-free, then 2 years at half rent; separate housing and service terms
amountZh: 符合条件的办公空间三年免租，后两年租金减半；住房及服务另有条款
eligibility: Selected OPC and small-team projects admitted by the community. The August 2026 operator report is not a tenancy offer for every applicant. Confirm current selection, eligible premises, deposits, service charges and exit terms in writing.
eligibilityZh: 由社区筛选入驻的OPC及小团队项目。2026年8月运营报告并非向所有申请者发出的租赁承诺，须书面确认现行遴选、适用空间、押金、服务费及退出条款。
status: Published service; current terms to confirm
deadline: Confirm current community admission and tenancy terms
deadlineZh: 确认社区现行入驻及租赁条款

name: Xuhui Qingmiao early AI investment route
zh: 徐汇青苗基金早期AI投资渠道
amount: Manager-reviewed early-stage investment; no universal cheque or equity percentage verified
amountZh: 由管理人审核早期投资，未核实统一投资额或股权比例
eligibility: Youth-led early AI projects matching the fund mandate. The August 2026 camp notice documents investment activity and organizers, not an always-open application or guaranteed grant. Request the responsible manager, screening pack, local-operation conditions and term sheet.
eligibilityZh: 符合基金方向的青年早期AI项目。2026年8月创业营公告证明存在投资活动及组织方，并不证明始终开放申请或保证获得补助。须索取负责管理人、筛选材料、属地经营条件及投资条款清单。
deadline: Manager-led sourcing and due diligence
deadlineZh: 管理人开展项目筛选与尽调
